mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a guest suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a guest suite depends on whether you remodel existing interior space, convert a garage, or construct a brand-new ground-up addition. Adding a ground-up structure involves major site work, foundations, framing, exterior finishes like stucco, and extending plumbing lines, which requires a larger budget. In contrast, converting an underutilized bonus room or garage uses existing walls and rooflines, though it still requires dedicated electrical circuits, HVAC routing, drywall, and bathroom rough-ins. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms provides detailed estimates after evaluating your existing layout and utility access.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on whether you convert existing interior square footage or build a new foundation and room addition. An on-site consultation determines exact pricing.
